cases.title: HTTP contract: POST /v1/auth/logout then protected API returns 401 Unauthenticated
preconditions: Authenticated user of any role holds valid accessToken from POST /v1/auth/login per AC-26.
steps: POST /v1/auth/logout with Authorization Bearer accessToken; assert HTTP 200 and data.loggedOut true per API §4.1.
Discard Authorization header to simulate BR-24 client credential discard.
GET /v1/me without Authorization; assert HTTP 401 with error.code Unauthenticated.
POST /v1/check-ins without Authorization with probe payload; assert HTTP 401 Unauthenticated.
cases.expected: BR-24 outcome at API boundary: logout acknowledges session end; subsequent protected requests without valid token return 401 Unauthenticated and no privileged data is returned.

cases.title: M01 authenticate middleware short-circuits protected requests after logout credential discard
preconditions: Integration harness wires M01 createAuthenticate middleware with real request context.
Authenticated actor resolved from valid bearer token in fixture.
steps: Bind valid actor to request via bearer token and confirm handler would proceed.
Invoke POST /v1/auth/logout through auth route handler.
Simulate client credential discard by omitting Authorization on subsequent protected route preHandler.
Assert middleware returns 401 Unauthenticated before business logic executes.
Verify UserLoggedOut event emitted with actorUserId per API §8.1 without attendance mutations.
cases.expected: Authentication guard enforces BR-24: cleared credentials yield 401 at middleware boundary without partial handler execution; logout emits UserLoggedOut only.

cases.title: Scenario matrix row for BR-24 end authenticated session on logout
preconditions: Testing-plan §12 Authentication lifecycle row applies (FR-36, FR-38; BR-05, BR-24; AC-06, AC-26).
Role-matrix fixture provides Student and Lecturer authenticated sessions.
steps: Establish authenticated session for each role via POST /v1/auth/login.
Execute voluntary logout per FLOW-15: POST /v1/auth/logout and client credential discard.
Attempt protected API read for each role without re-login (GET /v1/me).
Attempt protected frontend route deep link without re-login and confirm redirect to PG-01.
cases.expected: BR-24 enforced across roles: client credentials cleared, PG-01 login redirect on protected routes, API returns 401 Unauthenticated until re-authentication; no privileged data from prior session remains accessible.

cases.title: Browser journey: lecturer logout from PG-04 clears storage and gates session list until re-login
preconditions: Lecturer authenticated at PG-04 with visible session rows.
Browser storage holds accessToken and role-specific auth flags prior to logout.
steps: Activate Đăng xuất from staff shell and observe PG-01 load without returnUrl.
Verify accessToken and role-specific auth flags cleared from browser storage per FLOW-15 step 3.
Navigate to /lecturer/sessions and confirm login redirect.
Verify no privileged session or roster data remains visible in DOM.
Complete FRM-01 sign-in and confirm PG-04 session list renders again.
cases.expected: BR-24 browser outcome: voluntary logout clears client session, redirects to PG-01, blocks protected lecturer routes, and restores access only after re-authentication.

cases.title: Staff SidebarNav logout returns to PG-01 and blocks protected deep link until re-login
preconditions: Lecturer logged in on desktop Chromium at PG-04 /lecturer/sessions.
Open session fixture with known sessionId; SidebarNav footer exposes Đăng xuất per 09-page-list.md §2.2.
steps: Locate Đăng xuất control in sidebar footer separated from primary nav items.
Activate logout control and observe navigation to PG-01 without returnUrl query parameter.
Manually navigate to /lecturer/sessions/{sessionId}/roster.
Observe redirect to PG-01 login without roster data from prior session visible in DOM.
Re-authenticate and confirm PG-06 loads.
cases.expected: BR-24 UI gate: staff voluntary logout is reachable from authenticated shell, returns to PG-01, and protected deep links redirect to login without exposing prior session data.

cases.title: POST /v1/auth/logout without bearer token returns Unauthenticated
preconditions: Test client holds no Authorization header or bearer token.
steps: Send POST /v1/auth/logout without Authorization header.
Inspect HTTP status and response envelope error.code.
cases.expected: API returns HTTP 401 with error.code Unauthenticated per API §4.1; no loggedOut success payload without authentication.

cases.title: Post-logout denial on role-scoped APIs until re-authentication
preconditions: Student and Lecturer each completed FLOW-15 logout with client credentials cleared.
Open session with valid qrToken and sessionId exists for denial probes.
steps: Without Authorization, Student calls POST /v1/check-ins with valid qrToken and Idempotency-Key.
Without Authorization, Lecturer calls GET /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/attendance.
Inspect each response for HTTP 401 and error.code Unauthenticated with no attendance or roster data.
Re-authenticate Student and confirm POST /v1/check-ins or GET /v1/me succeeds with valid token.
cases.expected: BR-24 request evaluation pipeline rejects post-logout calls at authentication step with HTTP 401 Unauthenticated; no role-scoped attendance or session data is returned until re-login.
